title: Fixed Rounded Hook Stone and Tapered Grip Burnisher
description: One newly authored complete fixed agate-burnisher-inspired hand tool. A short thick continuously curved opaque stone-look head swells from its narrow buried root and turns into a broad rounded blunt end; its elliptical sections stay finite and have no sharpened blade, hollow flute or engraved marks. A long whole tapered wooden-look grip and one full annular warm-metal collar join the stone in a single fixed assembly. The original grip has a complete flat underside facet at the resting datum; the curved head is raised slightly above that plane. All numerical paths, sections and coordinates are new, not a crescent sickle blade, an old hollow U gouge, brush, stylus or other extracted mesh. Three closed editable bodies, four constant opaque PBR roles, metre scale and native Z up, one model zero scenes. Generic category appearance only; no actual agate mineral identification, natural banding, translucency, copied museum or branded tool, gold leaf, workpiece, polishing/burnishing result, process, tool fit, fabrication, load, handling or safety claim. Intentional hidden root overlaps are static visual assembly, not insertion tolerances. No rig or animation.
